shared_elements: round-topped stele field with figural scene above and text below
sun disc with radiating rays ending in hands
royal figure(s) with tall crown facing offerings
register divisions with horizontal lines of writing
smaller subsidiary figures at one side
justification: Both are round-topped stelae showing a rayed sun disc in the arch whose rays descend over a laden offering stand, with a crowned figure and consort facing it in profile and smaller attendant figures behind, above ruled bands of script. The main difference is proportion of scene to text (B devotes most of the surface to long text registers while A shows a second register of seated/standing figures) and the number of subsidiary figures.
